kill_fact: No kill. I attacked all four vectors and the asymmetry survived primary-source verification. (a) CATALYST LIVE, DATED, BINDING: Zymeworks' own Q1 2026 release (7 May 2026, filed as 8-K Ex-99.1, CIK 0001937653) states verbatim 'PDUFA target action date of August 25, 2026' for zanidatamab in first-line HER2-positive unresectable locally advanced or metastatic gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma, sBLA accepted with Priority Review, Breakthrough Therapy Designation granted. NOT fired, NOT slipped: the last ZYME 8-K is 29 June 2026 (Theravance) and the last press release is 16 July 2026 (Q2 date); no CRL, no extension, no AdCom announcement on the tape as of 28 July 2026. Spread is not closed: $23.00 live vs a $29 event-resolved target. (b) TARGET REAL, AND THE MOST ATTACKABLE CLAIM VERIFIED: the payout is contractual and, critically, UNPLEDGED. The 7 May 2026 release states 'Zymeworks is entitled to receive a $250.0 million milestone payment from Jazz related to approval of Ziihera in GEA in the United States,' and the 2 March 2026 Royalty Pharma 8-K states verbatim 'All earned regulatory and commercial milestone payments under the Covered Agreements will be retained by the Company, including up to $440.0 million in near-term milestone payments tied to future regulatory approvals of Ziihera in mGEA.' The Royalty Pharma note therefore takes 30% of ROYALTIES only and does NOT touch the $250M. The bull's haircut of the royalty leg is correct and its milestone leg is clean. (c) FLOOR: both debts confirmed genuinely non-recourse in primary text (RP note 'non-recourse royalty-backed note' with security granted only by a ring-fenced Subsidiary over its own assets; OMERS note 'do not have any recourse to the remainder of the Zymeworks' business'). No going-concern, no ATM, no equity or convertible issuance in the filing record (only an S-8 for employee plans), no financing contingency, no antitrust second request disclosed. (d) The one real defect is a SEQUENCING error in the floor, not a break -- see corrections. Prior skeptic pass of 27 July flagged the undisclosed RP note and the mislabelled 'existing GEA approval'; BOTH have since been absorbed and corrected in the current dossier, which now discloses the note, the 30% pledge and the Nov-2024 BTC-only approval accurately.
corrections: (1) MATERIAL, floor sequencing: the dossier builds floor plank one on PRO-FORMA cash of '$6.70 to $7.50 per share' and plank three on YUPELRI, but the Theravance acquisition is only 'expected to close in the second half of 2026, subject to shareholder approval and customary closing conditions' (TBPH release, 29 June 2026) and the shareholder vote is still pending as of 28 July 2026. The close can therefore land AFTER the 25 August 2026 PDUFA. On the actual event date the balance sheet is most likely still standalone Zymeworks -- $403.8M at 31 March 2026 less burn and buybacks on ~73.0M shares, roughly $5.2-5.5 per share, with NO YUPELRI cash stream and no $360M of Theravance cash. Planks one and three are thinner on the day the binary resolves than the dossier represents. This does not break the floor (the ~$14-16 pre-data trading range that anchors the $18 estimate was itself a standalone-Zymeworks range, so the estimate survives by coincidence), but the stated per-share cash figure is not the balance sheet that will exist on 25 August. (2) MATERIAL, factually wrong: the buyback claim that 'roughly $29 million of the $125 million authorisation still unspent' nets the wrong program. Per the 14 May 2026 release, the 2025 program was TERMINATED after repurchasing 4,197,553 shares for $102.3 million at an average of $24.36, and a NEW 2026 authorization of up to $125.0 million was approved that same day. The $95.8M/3.93M-share figure as of 6 May belongs to the terminated 2025 program. Remaining 2026 capacity is up to $125.0M less purchases since 14 May -- materially MORE than $29M. Direction of the error favours the bull: the green flag is understated, not overstated. The average repurchase price of $24.36 does sit above today's $23.00 as claimed. (3) MINOR, stale figures: the dossier cites 'up to $862.5 million of commercial milestones' and a deal 'worth up to about $1.76 billion.' The 2 March 2026 8-K states 'up to $977.5 million in potential commercial milestone payments,' plus '$89.0 million regulatory milestones for third indications beyond biliary tract cancer and mGEA,' 'for total potential remaining payments of up to $1.5 billion.' (4) MINOR, unverified additions: the dossier adds to the Theravance CVR 'a $50 million payment on first commercial sale in one of six major markets, and a 10% sales royalty.' The 29 June 2026 primary announcements describe the CVR only as 80% of net proceeds from any future license, divestiture or monetization of ampreloxetine over ten years, with the remaining 20% to Zymeworks. Unverified extras; if wrong they understate what Zymeworks retains. Context the dossier omits: ampreloxetine FAILED, which is what triggered Theravance's strategic review -- so the CVR is written on a low-expected-value asset, which favours the buyer. (5) MINOR, royalty tiering: the dossier's '10% to 20%' is close but loose; the 8-K specifies Jazz tiered royalties of 'ten to high teens percentages' up to $2.0 billion of annual net sales and '20% on annual net sales above $2.0 billion.' (6) NOT VERIFIED either way: the 'no advisory committee scheduled' claim and the 85-90% approval probability could not be independently confirmed against an FDA primary page (session web-search budget exhausted; FDA/SEC browse endpoints 403 to the fetcher). No contrary evidence found, but the AdCom-absence tell is an unconfirmed input to a load-bearing probability. (7) JUDGEMENT, not a fact correction: the dossier's own arithmetic concedes a raw 1.2-to-1 spread (+26% / -22%) and that 'much of the approval is in the price.' A single-agency binary whose edge is entirely probability-weighting, on a floor that is explicitly a trading estimate rather than a contractual one, is a thin base for the top conviction tier.
